long_biography.plain_text:
Trained in information technology and computer science, Benjamin Jean Mauerberger began as a systems administrator before moving into investment consulting. His work has covered corporate finance, financial-risk management, fundraising, growth strategy and assessments of company performance for businesses with international ambitions.

One assignment involved advising an American public company on merger partners, senior-management recruitment and growth initiatives. Other advisory work involved an LED manufacturer, a cosmetics group and a clean-energy company. The assignments ranged from arranging capital and public-market listings to planning overseas plants and supporting entry into new markets across London, North America and Asia.
